notes:
Lead source: inbound trial sign-up from content marketing webinar. Product: content generation platform for SMB publishers and agencies.

Quick context: Meadowbeam operates a templated article engine + multi-variant headlines. They push daily batches: ~60-120k generated items/week, averaging ~150k tokens/day on peak campaigns. Extremely cost sensitive — COGS per 1k tokens must be predictable. Interested in Redwood hosted API (self-serve) for fast onboarding.

Highlights from discovery call (2025-01-18):
- AE (Riley) intro + use-case walkthrough. Demo request for batching/caching patterns.
- CTO (Jordan Miles): "We need predictable cost per variant; caching prefix identical intro paragraphs would cut costs."
- Operations: currently running on a mix of small VM endpoints + OpenAI pay-as-you-go; experimenting with 7B open models locally.
- Wants built-in batching + prefix/KV caching and quantization recommendations to reduce spend.

Tech constraints: public cloud only today, no on-prem/VPC. No heavy compliance needs but they prefer SOC2 and audit logs for partnership deals. Prefers simple SSO later.

Trial activity: sandbox API key provisioned 2025-01-20, ran 3 batch jobs (headline variants + article intros). Observed tokens/sec variance when sending >200 concurrent requests — asked about rate-limit bump for POC.

Sales notes: treat as high-velocity SMB motion. Emphasize predictable per-token economics, batching guidance, and sample optimize settings. Pricing sensitivity: wants a modeled cost comparison vs current OpenAI usage.

Quote / ask: "If we can drop our cost by 30% with same quality and give a simple caching strategy, we'll consolidate."
